Corollary
[First conjugate point in positive constant curvature]

↗ ex:dc-ch5-3-3 ↗ def:dc-ch5-3-1 ↗ lem:dc-ch8-2-1-no-conjugate Let $M^n$ have constant sectional curvature $K_0>0$, with $n\geq 2$, and let $\gamma \colon [0,\pi /\sqrt{K_0}]\to M$ be a unit-speed geodesic. Then $\gamma (\pi /\sqrt{K_0})$ is the first conjugate point to $\gamma (0)$ along $\gamma $. Indeed, the sine Jacobi fields of section ex:dc-ch5-3-3 give conjugacy at the endpoint, while the constant-curvature non-conjugacy criterion rules out every $0<t<\pi /\sqrt{K_0}$.
